text_simplified: The text speaks of the importance of tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon good akhlaq (character) and following the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It points out that the Companions were keen to teach their children religious values and upright conduct. It also clarifies that play and recreation can be a means to teach children and enhance their intelligence. Parents are advised to guide their children toward beneficial play that develops their abilities.
